actions.description: Load and validate a business config: sender, offer ladder, segments, banned words, allowed proof points and booking link. Call first, before scoring or drafting.
actions.name: learn_offer

actions.description: Score a leads CSV against the ICP segments. Returns fit 0 to 100, tier A/B/C and auditable reasons per lead. Dedupes and drops invalid or suppressed emails.
actions.name: score_icp

actions.description: Draft one personal email per tier A/B lead that has a checkable personal signal. Every draft is status draft_needs_approval. Leads without a signal are blocked, never blasted generically. Nothing is sent.
actions.name: draft_emails

actions.description: Classify a reply as hot, hot_escalate, negative, out_of_office or warm_unclear, with the safe next action. Pricing and contract replies always escalate to a human.
actions.name: triage_reply

actions.description: From campaign results (segment, sent, hot leads), compute cost per hot lead and return scale, pause or keep_testing per segment.
actions.name: learn_results

author: Lionel Sim, The AI Capitol
description: A personal AI agent plugin for go-to-market: learn an offer, score leads against an ICP, draft one-to-one personal emails for human approval, triage replies, and learn which segments to scale or pause. Use it when a founder or revenue team wants an Explee-style outbound motion without vendor lock-in, a proprietary lead database, or auto-sending.
name: auto-gtm-agent
